geometry.bounds_reason: A sharp rectangular pad can share the same envelope. Rounded-pad volume and a corner-distance probe are required.

solidcraft_only.native_expectation: The result is one joined body: an 80 x 60 x 5 mm base plate with a centered 40 x 30 x 8 mm rounded pad on top. The Rounded pad sketch has one closed profile made from four straight edges and four corner arcs. SolidCraft 0.42 also adds one construction diagonal between opposite arc centres; that construction line is not part of the profile.
